name: Tomato Superstar
description: a glossy red cartoon tomato character, rounded Pixar-style 3D, smooth skin with a soft highlight, a curved green stem-and-leaf cap tilted to one side, large expressive eyes with thick dark eyebrows, short stubby arms and legs
voice: bright theatrical young male voice, Hinglish, like a stage announcer who believes every word
signature: spreads both stubby arms wide when he announces something
doNot: no hat other than the green stem cap
